::: {#rem-score-notation}
#### Notation for the score function

We often omit the arguments $\vx$ and $\theta$,
writing $\score \eqdef \score(\vx \mid \theta) \eqdef \score(\theta)$.
Some sources write $U$ or $S$ for the score function instead of $\score$;
for example, @dobson4e write $U$.
These notes use $\score$,
which keeps $U$ and $S$ free for other uses
and needs no extra symbol to memorize.
:::
